echo_sets.name: Empyrean Anthem
echo_sets.note: Bolsters his coordinated-attack DMG; Nightmare: Tempest Mephis adds Electro DMG Bonus and Resonance Skill DMG.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Support-oriented option: Outro ATK buff for the incoming character plus Bell-Borne's shield and DEF.

echo_sets.name: Empyrean Anthem + Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: While farming a full 5-piece set; keeps Electro DMG and coordinated-attack bonuses online.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; Energy Regen is not a substat priority — Abyss Surges' 12.8% Energy Regen passive covers his Liberation needs
build.fast_path: Fast path: Abyss Surges + 5-piece Empyrean Anthem in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Tempest Mephis in the main slot. Crit Rate/Crit DMG 4-cost, Electro DMG 3-costs, DEF% 1-costs. Drop Thunder Wedge, swap out — it keeps dealing coordinated Electro damage off-field while you DPS with your carry.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's best weapon for Yuanwu: Energy Regen to cycle his Liberation plus Basic/Resonance Skill DMG bonuses that fit his combo. Not his signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Amity Accord
ranked_weapons.note: 4-star alternative; DEF substat matches his scaling plus Resonance Liberation DMG bonus.

ranked_weapons.name: Stonard
ranked_weapons.note: Resonance Skill cast boosts Liberation DMG — cheap standard-pool pick that fits his rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Marcato
ranked_weapons.note: Restores Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill; smooths his swap-heavy playstyle.

ranked_weapons.name: Originite: Type IV
ranked_weapons.note: Craftable support option; Prydwen's recommended pick for running him as a Rejuvenating Glow coordinated-attack bot.

stat_priorities.note: Crit main stat; balance to the 1:2 ratio.
DEF% on both — his Thunder Wedge and Liberation scale off DEF.

profile.role_note: DEF-scaling off-field sub-DPS; his Thunder Wedge persists after swapping out and deals coordinated Electro DMG, and his Outro shreds enemy Vibration Strength.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free from clearing Tower of Adversity's Stable Zone, so never pull for him. A low-investment off-field Electro sub-DPS and vibration-strength shredder — niche, but he asks almost nothing of your account to function.

sources.record: Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Xiangli Yao
members.note: Electro main DPS; Yuanwu's off-field coordinated attacks feed his rotation while he stays on-field.

members.name: Yuanwu
members.note: Drops Thunder Wedge for persistent off-field damage, then swaps out; re-enters to detonate it at full Forte.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Premium healer/buffer; Stellarealm Crit buffs and healing for the team's quick swaps.

teams.name: Premium: Xiangli Yao + Yuanwu + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens for buffs, Yuanwu drops Thunder Wedge and swaps out immediately, Xiangli Yao takes the field for his full combo — swap back to Yuanwu when Concerto is full to detonate the wedge and Outro, staggering elites via Vibration Strength shred.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Takes the on-field carry slot in this fully free team; their Liberation is the burst window.

members.name: Yuanwu
members.note: Keeps Thunder Wedge down for off-field coordinated Electro damage throughout the rotation.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free universal healer/buffer; documented support replacement whose Outro deepens team damage.

teams.name: Budget: Spectro Rover + Yuanwu + Verina
teams.rotation: Yuanwu enters first to drop Thunder Wedge and build Concerto, swaps to Spectro Rover for on-field damage inside the wedge's AoE — the wedge also charges Yuanwu's Forte off-field — then back to Yuanwu to detonate at full Forte before looping.

tier_badge.label: Strong
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates him B overall as a Sub-DPS and Beebom's October 2026 3.7 tier list places him at B — a free, low-investment off-field Electro sub-DPS with a unique Vibration Strength shred, held back by a small wedge AoE and swap-heavy playstyle.
